name: Non-Tech Startups Needing Enablement Through Tech

pain_points: Risk of building the wrong thing
Need system to deliver and measure outcomes
buying_signals: Need platform to run business model

fit_logic.proceed: They have a clear delivery model and need enablement + proof
fit_logic.park: Idea is vague, no owner, no cadence, no budget
fit_logic.stop: Need deep bespoke product-market fit discovery before any platform makes sense

what_they_sell: A service or subscription. They need proof to win trust and improve fast.
what_proof_means: Evidence the service works, that users progress, that retention is improving.
yoke_strengths: Progress mechanics (nudges, gamification, checkpoints) to drive retention
yoke_weaknesses: If they need deep bespoke product-market fit discovery before any platform makes sense

messaging.value_proposition: Yoke helps non-tech startups launch service delivery systems quickly—with built-in measurement and retention mechanics.
key_benefits: Launch fast without building from scratch
Iterate based on real outcomes data
messaging.elevator_pitch: Non-tech startups need delivery systems but lack tech capability. Yoke provides a fast-to-live foundation with measurement—so you can launch and iterate quickly.

two_lever_framing.lever_a: Increase service retention and user progress
two_lever_framing.lever_b: Reduce launch time and build costs
